title: I Found The EASIEST Way to Make Money with Amazon KDP
summary: KDP seller shows holiday word-search and activity books said to earn hundreds a day and how to make them with an affiliate book tool, AI word lists and cheap outsourced covers.

assertions.quote: you just upload a PDF and that is it
during these holidays activity books like word searches sells extremely well
books with a two star average rating is making hundreds of dollars a day

verdicts.note: The figures are tool estimates for a handful of top sellers; most low-content books sell few or no copies in a crowded category.

assertions.quote: Easter word search One review and making $57 to $75 a day in actual royalties
this is extremely easy nowadays with AI
you do that enough times of the year and your income will be fairly steady throughout the year

verdicts.note: Stacking seasonal titles smooths income somewhat, but each holiday spike is short and competitive and the fourth quarter still dominates.
